question: In Pancreatic trials, normalize the type of follow-up into imaging, clinical, or mixed.

steps.desc: Filter Pancreatic trials and select follow-up text.
Map free text to controlled follow-up categories.
steps.prompt: For each row, read Type of follow-up given and emit JSON {NCT, PMID, follow_up_type} with label in ["imaging","clinical","mixed","unknown"]. Heuristics: imaging if scans/CT/MRI/PET/RECIST dominate; clinical if visits/labs/AE monitoring dominate; mixed if both explicitly; unknown if insufficient. Output JSON objects only—one per input row; no prose.

steps.desc: Validate label set and drop invalid rows.
